name: Bildad
overview: Bildad the Shuhite is introduced in Job 2:11 as one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him in his suffering. Throughout the book of Job, Bildad repeatedly responds to Job's plight, as seen in Job 8:1, 18:1, and 25:1, where he speaks to challenge Job's perspective. His speeches reflect a consistent role as a friend who seeks to address Job's situation, emphasizing a viewpoint that aligns with traditional understandings of divine justice.
